args: Per-change base branch — record base_branch in .status.yaml and make every base-relative surface read it. fab has no per-change base branch: fab pr-meta, WriteTrueImpact, the review dispatch, fab-adopt, and git-pr all derive the base from the repo default (Go hardcodes origin/main→origin/master, ignoring origin/HEAD), so a stacked PR's Impact/true_impact/review diff absorb the parent branch's delta. Record base_branch at branch creation (default: resolved default branch; operator stacked-prs sets the dependency branch), have all five surfaces read it, unify the two Go merge-base helpers, ship a migration, fail-open to the default branch when absent.
